user.title: Kostal Plenticore Battery Control

data.modbus_timeout: Modbus Timeout (sec, from Inverter Web UI)

user.description:
Enter connection details for your Kostal Inverter.

**IMPORTANT:** Remember to change Battery Management to "External via protocol (Modbus TCP)" in the battery settings on the Inverter Web UI. (This requires installer code access).

**Unit ID** should be **71** for battery management registers on Plenticore inverters.

battery_management.title: ⚠️ Battery Management Is Not Set to Modbus
battery_management.description:
Your inverter reports its battery management as:

**{current_mode}**

This integration controls the battery by writing to Modbus registers, and the inverter **silently ignores every one of those writes** unless battery management is set to Modbus. Charge and discharge switches will appear to work but nothing will happen.

To fix it, log in to the Inverter Web UI as **Installer**, go to **Settings → Battery Management**, and change it to **"External via protocol (Modbus TCP)"**.

You can continue setup now and change the inverter setting afterwards — the sensors will work either way. Submit to continue.

ksem.title: KOSTAL Smart Energy Meter (KSEM) Detected
ksem.description:
A KOSTAL Smart Energy Meter (KSEM) was detected as the connected energy meter on your inverter.

You can optionally enter the KSEM's IP address to read energy import and export values directly from it via Modbus TCP.

**Leave the field empty to skip KSEM setup.** All other sensors will still work normally.

grid_source.title: No Smart Meter Detected
grid_source.description:
No smart meter is connected to your inverter, so the integration cannot see grid import and export by itself.

You can optionally pick a Home Assistant entity that measures grid power at the connection point — **positive while importing, negative while exporting** (W). This adds an **Inverter Control** switch that charges or discharges the battery to keep the grid near zero.

**Leave the field empty to skip.** Charge Start, Discharge Start and the block switches still work normally. You can add or change the entity later under **Configure**.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the inverter. Check IP address, port, and Unit ID.
error.cannot_connect_ksem: Unable to connect to the KSEM. Check the IP address or leave the field empty to skip.

init.title: Inverter Control (External Grid Entity)
init.description: Pick a Home Assistant entity that measures grid power at the connection point — **positive while importing, negative while exporting** (W). While a grid entity is selected, an **Inverter Control** switch trims grid import/export by charging or discharging the battery. Clear the entity to remove the switch.{meter_note}
